title: update_ci_config
description: Applies structured changes to a CI/CD pipeline configuration file such as a GitHub Actions workflow, CircleCI config, or Jenkinsfile.

pipeline_file.description: Path to the CI/CD pipeline configuration file to modify (e.g. '.github/workflows/ci.yml', '.circleci/config.yml').

changes.description: A map of configuration keys or dot-separated paths to their new values representing the changes to apply to the pipeline file.
